name.en: A Soldier from the Fusion Dimension: Sora Perse

notes: The following rewards were awarded during this event, based on event points accumulated over the course of the event:

rows.text: Card Sleeves: A Soldier from the Fusion Dimension: Sora Perse
Game Mat: A Soldier from the Fusion Dimension: Sora Perse
Title: A Soldier from the Fusion Dimension: Sora Perse Completed

notes: When Dueling against Sora Perse at Level 40 or higher, these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop.

The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remains open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
These missions were available from the start of the event.
